title: Treatment of peri-implantitis of extraoral craniofacial endosseous implants: a scoping review
html: This scoping review was performed to synthesize the currently available evidence on the management of peri-implantitis affecting extraoral craniofacial endosseous implants, a condition that presents unique anatomical and microbiological challenges. Although a recently proposed treatment algorithm has gained attention in the literature, it is based on low-level evidence and is overly complex for routine clinical use, serving primarily as a conceptual or research-oriented framework. Pragmatic, evidence-based guidelines tailored to extraoral craniofacial endosseous implants remain lacking.
